history.summary: Neighbourhood Jagannath temple at B/199, Block E, Sector 2, Vaishali, Ghaziabad (directory listings and geocoder full-address match), served by Odiya priests and a hub for the Odia community in NCR; an adjacent Shiv Mandir is noted by reviewers. It was reportedly built on what was formerly a GDA public park (single visitor review; verify). Founding date and hours not found (verify). CSV town 'Ghaziabad' retained; actual locality is Vaishali, Ghaziabad.

name: Shree Jagannath Mandir
town_description: Ghaziabad is a large industrial city in western Uttar Pradesh on Delhi's eastern edge, part of the National Capital Region; its planned townships of Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar and Vaishali mix dense residential sectors with markets, parks and neighbourhood temples.

travel.railway: Nearest stations: Sahibabad / Anand Vihar Terminal, a short drive (verify)
travel.road: Sector 2, Vaishali, close to Anand Vihar ISBT, Delhi (verify)

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Rath Yatra is the peak
